Patient Billing Services

The Last Mile of the Revenue Cycle Is Also the Most Personal

Once an insurance claim is fully adjudicated, whatever is left, a deductible, a copay, a non-covered service, becomes the patient's bill. Patients now carry more of their own healthcare costs than ever through high-deductible health plans, which makes patient billing one of the fastest-growing pieces of a practice's total collections, and one of the easiest to get wrong.

Confusing statements, unexpected balances and unclear payment options are the leading reasons patients delay paying, or don't pay at all. That's rarely because they can't afford it, it's because the bill doesn't clearly explain what insurance covered, what's left, and how to pay it.

PMEX sends clean, accurate statements only after insurance is fully posted, follows up on overdue balances with a respectful, structured cadence, and gives patients payment options that make it easy to actually pay.
